In Orléans, you will recruit followers and put them to work to make use of their abilities. Farmers and Boatmen supply you with money and goods; Knights expand your scope of action and secure your mercantile expeditions; Craftsmen build trading stations and tools to facilitate work; Scholars make progress in science; Traders open up new locations for you to use your followers; and last but not least, it cannot hurt to get active in monasteries since with Monks on your side you are much less likely to fall prey to fate. You will always want to take more actions than possible, and there are many paths to victory. The challenge is to combine all elements as best as possible with regard to your strategy. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Overview 2 Setup Options 3 Phases of a Round 4 Actions Descriptions 4.1 Farmhouse 4.2 Village 4.3 University 4.4 Castle 4.5 Monastery 4.6 Ship 4.7 Wagon 4.8 Guildhall 4.9 Scriptorium 4.10 Town Hall 5 Torture (Bankruptcy) 6 End of the Game & Scoring 7 Additional Rules Overview Orléans is a bag-building, worker-placement game set in Medieval France. You will assemble knights, monks, farmers, and other characters to perform special actions. However, each round brings a new event that may help or hinder your plans for dominance. In the end, you will score points for coins, resources, trading posts, citizens, and progress on the development track. Setup Options Simultaneous Followers Phase The Followers Phase is played simultaneously. Players can draw followers from their bags simultaneously. Once all players are done, the Planning Phase begins. This speeds up the game, but you sacrifice small strategy aspects. Available Place Tiles ~ Market Normal - Place Tiles are shuffled into stacks (I and II). 13 Place Tiles are drawn at random from each stack and are used in the game. ~ Market 3 - The Place Tiles are shuffled into stacks (I and II). 3 Place Tiles of each stack are revealed and available to choose from. Once a Place Tile is chosen it is replaced with a new tile from the stack. ~ Market 5 - The Place Tiles are shuffled into stacks (I and II). 5 Place Tiles of each stack are revealed and available to choose from. Once a Place Tile is chosen it is replaced with a new tile from the stack. ~ Market All - All included Place Tiles are available. Place Tile Expansions It is not recommended to use these expansions with beginners ~ Orleans: Place Tiles N°1 is a mini-expansion for Orléans that consists of three new place tiles: Bakery, Goldsmith, and Lair. ~ Orleans: Place Tiles N°2 is a mini-expansion for Orléans that consists of three new place tiles: Barracks, Court, and Theatre. ~ Orleans: Place Tiles N°3 is a mini-expansion for Orléans that consists of three new place tiles: Port, Quarry, and Workshop. ~ Orleans: Place Tiles N°4 is a mini-expansion for Orléans that consists of three new place tiles: Bourgeois House, Lock, and Observatory. ~ Orleans: Place Tiles N°5 is a mini-expansion for Orléans that consists of three new place tiles: Road, Ballroom, and Church. Phases of a Round A round of Orleans consists of 7 phases, performed in this order: 1. Reveal a New Event Card: In BGA, the card is located at the top left corner of the screen, by your name. The event will resolve at the end of the round. There are 6 types of EVENTS in the game, each appearing three times: ~ PILGRIMAGE: Monks cannot be recruited this round (this is the only event that triggers at the start of the round) ~ INCOME: Receive coins for Development Track status. 3 coins per level in Phase A, 2 coins per level in Phase B, and 1 coin per level in Phase C. ~ HARVEST: Return food item(s) (grain, cheese or wine) to the general supply. [Rating: 1/10] Q: What do you get if you cross a cube pushing engine building euro with a Dominion - an engine building deck builder?  A: A box chock full of cardboard chits and wooden pieces and stuff.   Orleans a.k.a. Dominion the boardgame, reminds you that cards were there for a reason (making the game cheaper and smaller). Basically you're buying people tokens, throwing them in a bag and pulling them out, and you need 2-3 of a specific kind to make an action.
